This foundational information gap resulted in the Planner making multiple repetitive requests for additional queries in an attempt to address the lack of clarity in the WebSurfer’s outputs. Despite repeated searches, no progress was made in conclusively validating Bamboo's credentials as a musician, which prolonged the task unnecessarily and prevented final resolution. Moreover, critical information confirming Bamboo Mañalac as a musician and his prominent musical roles was already accessible in initial results (e.g., Wikipedia, Biographics World). The WebSurfer should have presented and emphasized these verified findings instead of requiring multiple repetitive searches. This misstep cascaded into inefficiencies and unresolved ambiguities throughout the conversation.**
